Container.Name: INTERCEPT
Container.Overview: INTERCEPT is a web-based Signal Intelligence platform for software-defined radio. After first start, sign in and complete the on-screen setup wizard (observer location, USB SDR check, default mode). Privileged mode and USB passthrough are required for RTL-SDR, HackRF, and similar dongles. Do not expose this container to the Internet.
Container.Requires: Unraid with Docker enabled, a USB controller for SDR dongles, and enough RAM for decoder processes. Map instance storage to a cache/pool disk when possible — Unraid user shares (/mnt/user) are FUSE and are a poor fit for SQLite WAL.

Config.Name: WebUI
Config.Description: INTERCEPT web interface. Do not port-forward this to the Internet.

Config.Name: USB devices
Config.Description: Host USB bus so RTL-SDR, HackRF, and similar dongles appear inside the container.

Config.Name: Application database
Config.Description: SQLite settings, users, and TLE cache. Prefer a cache/pool path, not /mnt/user.

Config.Name: Capture data
Config.Description: Weather-sat, radiosonde, Sub-GHz, and ADS-B capture files.

Config.Name: Environment file
Config.Description: Persisted .env written by the setup wizard (observer location and other INTERCEPT_* keys).

Config.Name: Admin username
Config.Description: Web UI login name. Change the password below before first start.

Config.Name: Admin password
Config.Description: Web UI password. Required. Do not leave this as admin.

Config.Name: Observer latitude
Config.Description: Optional. Decimal degrees. The in-app wizard can also set this.

Config.Name: Observer longitude
Config.Description: Optional. Decimal degrees. The in-app wizard can also set this.

Config.Name: Log level
Config.Description: Python log level: DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR.

Config.Name: Listen port
Config.Description: Container listen port. Keep in sync with the WebUI port mapping.

Config.Name: Env file path
Config.Description: Wizard-managed environment file inside the config volume.

Config.Name: Unraid install
Config.Description: Marks this container as an Unraid Community Applications install so the setup wizard shows USB and storage guidance.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: Unraid nobody user ID. INTERCEPT still needs privileged USB access for SDR tools.
